newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore bank loans up 1 pct in Aug over July.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore bank loans up 1 pct in Aug over July.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Monday outstanding loans extended by offshore banking units through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF) rose to 1,266.9 billion baht ($50.7 billion) at end-August from 1,254.7 billion a month earlier.
It said the end-August outstanding BIBF loans were 39 percent higher than 911.4 billion baht posted a year ago.
The bank said BIBF loans brought in by commercial banks for relending to domestic borrowers rose 0.2 percent to 769.4 billion baht at end-August from 767.8 billion at end-July.
Cumulative foreign loans handled by offshore banking units here for third country borrowers amounted to 497.5 billion baht at end-August, up from 486.9 billion the previous month.
